3

Scope of Data Collected

When using the Chataptor service, we may collect the following categories of data:

3.1 Data provided by the user

  • Name and surname
  • Email address
  • Phone number
  • Company name and position
  • Message content in conversations

3.2 Data collected automatically

  • IP address
  • Browser type and version
  • Operating system
  • Screen resolution
  • Time and date of visit
  • Pages viewed
  • Traffic source (referrer)
4

We process your personal data for the following purposes:

Service Provision

Chat support, message translation, platform functionality

6

Data Transfer Outside EEA

In some cases, your data may be transferred outside the European Economic Area (EEA), e.g., to servers located in the USA. In such cases, we apply appropriate safeguards, including standard contractual clauses.

7

Data Retention Period

We retain your data for the period necessary to fulfill processing purposes:

Data Type Retention Period
Account data Duration of use + 3 years
Conversation history Duration of use + 1 year
Analytics data Maximum 26 months
Billing data, if paid services are introduced 5 years (tax regulations)
8

Your Rights

Under GDPR, you have the following rights:

Right of Access

You can obtain information about your processed data

Right to Rectification

You can request correction of inaccurate data

Right to Erasure

You can request deletion of data ("right to be forgotten")

Right to Restriction

You can request restriction of processing

Right to Data Portability

You can receive data in a machine-readable format

Right to Object

You can object to data processing

To exercise these rights, please contact us at iodo@browin.pl.

You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority - the President of the Personal Data Protection Office (PUODO).

9

Cookies

Chataptor uses cookies to ensure proper operation, analyze traffic, and personalize content.

9.1 Types of Cookies

Essential

Required for site operation (session, authorization)

Functional

Remembering user preferences

Analytical

Google Analytics (with IP anonymization)

Marketing

Google Ads (with user consent)

9.2 Managing Cookies

You can manage cookies through your browser settings. Please note that disabling certain cookies may affect site functionality.

10

Data Security

We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data:

Connection encryption (SSL/TLS)
Data encryption at rest
Regular backups
Role-based access control
Threat monitoring and detection
Regular security audits
